illustrated:
Top-down illustrated board-game map of Venezuela. Full map fills square 1:1 canvas, north at top. No text, labels, UI, people or characters. Geography arranged faithfully west to east, north to south: Far west large blue Lake Maracaibo, shore oil derricks, Catatumbo lightning and long bridge. Northwest dry coast with Falcón Médanos de Coro sand dunes and cacti. Southwest snowy Mérida Andes with cable car and pine trees. North-center colorful dense Caracas hillside barrios and twin skyscrapers below green El Ávila with cable car, metro entrance and coastline adjacent. Center-south golden-green Los Llanos plains with cattle, palms, winding river, ranch houses, capybaras. Northeast turquoise Caribbean, white beaches, Mochima cliff bay and boats; Margarita island palms and ferry; Los Roques small coral ring further offshore. East Orinoco branching into mysterious purple-green mangrove delta, floating huts, fog, floating arepa and lone door in water, surreal does-not-exist zone. Southeast green jungle highlands with tall flat-topped tepuis and enormous Angel Falls, copper-brown Guayana industrial river city beside big river. Bottom edge Amazon jungle fades into soft clouds. Leave broad uncluttered open ground and routes between regions for game spaces added later. Light blue rivers, thin pale dirt roads. Each region clearly separated by distinct palette. Lighting top-left. Readable at small size. Avoid text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, people, human characters, flags, political borders, photorealism, 3D render, blur, dark or muddy colors, cluttered paths, tiny details.
Style: stylized cartoon Mario Party world map crossed with vintage Latin American travel poster. Warm saturated colors, thick clean bold outlines, rounded shapes, soft hand-painted shading, flat-lit game board, charming humorous illustration.
